title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?

bias_targets.methodology: Incorporating historically accurate index constituent lists that explicitly include delisted and bankrupt stocks at each rolling evaluation period to prevent artificially inflating performance metrics by only evaluating currently active, successful assets.

Aligning multi-source structured and unstructured data inputs strictly chronologically with each backtest window, ensuring that strategies only utilize information available prior to the decision-making date without future knowledge leakage.

Implementing broad, composite rolling-window evaluations over extended periods (20 years) across dynamically selected stock universes, mitigating the risk of overfitting or performance inflation caused by repeated testing on narrow datasets.
